The 5 new large flow trades combined with model disagreement suggests institutional positioning changes, likely profit-taking or hedging by smart money while retail remains bullish. The shorter timeframe models are being influenced by the current momentum and vol suppression, while the 21-day champion model is detecting underlying structural weakness that longer-term positioning reveals.
